name: Scorching Thermal Shock Convergence · Water
primary:
A widening stream (up to 3 blocks wide) hits everyone in front of you; in instant mode it keeps going while held:
• Damage 4.5 ❤ fire + 2.25 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet, fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 21.6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Cold 72: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• If the target is frozen or brittle: damage 13 ❤ thermal
• Charge 63: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 8 targets in a row, jumps up to 6 blocks, 2.25 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Soaked for 12 s and leaves a puddle
• Knockback
